timing.method: Serial alternating baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate. Five fresh-engine trials, five untimed warmups, five batches of five warm calls per process. Three accepted processes each. Setup, allocation of result array and all validation untimed. No timing instrumentation. CPU sampled every 0.5 s; exclude whole process if any competing process >=60% is observed. Samples list competitors >=30%; lower ordinary desktop activity remains. No claim of zero unsampled contention.

Sample proportions characterize this instrumented source run, not plain-run latency fractions. Native console/assert wrappers are prominent; profiling overhead and transpilation limit transfer to bundled builds.
